newsitem.title: USA: Sun International sets Dec 16 deal closing.
newsitem.headline: Sun International sets Dec 16 deal closing.

text.p: Sun International Hotels Ltd said it will close its acquisition of Griffin Gaming & Entertainment Inc on December 16..
Sun International said it will also announce on December 16 its future development plans for Atlantic City.
Shareholders of both companies have approved the transaction, which calls for each share of Griffin common stock to be converted into 0.4324 shares of Sun International.

Based on Sun's stock price of 50-1/2, the deal values Griffin at $21.84 per share for a total value of $205 million. Upon comsummation of the deal, Griffin Gaming will be a wholly-owned subsidiary of Sun International.
Shares of Griffin were up 5/8 at 21-5/8.
